author: Dunk
description:
Few things in Warhammer 40k capture the imagination quite like a Dreadnought. Part tomb, part tank, it's one of those designs that somehow gets more compelling the more you learn about it. In this post, I'm celebrating the Dreadnought in all its forms, from the chunky, nostalgic charm of the classic sculpt to the modern Redemptor, and sharing some thoughts (and a hot take or two) on why these walking coffins have earned their place as one of 40k's most iconic designs.

The post Showcase: a love letter to the Space Marine Dreadnought, old and new appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Showcase: a love letter to the Space Marine Dreadnought, old and new
